card1.title: Showcase & Connect
card1.description: Join SNSA to showcase your company, share your expertise and connect with the people shaping the natural skincare industry. Meet experienced formulators, marketing specialists, scientists, influencers and other industry professionals. Consider also the opportunity to adopt the Quality Mark of SNSA to get officially recognised by our professional committee.

card2.title: Elevate Your Practice
card2.description: Whether you run a beauty salon, work as an aesthetician, skincare specialist or aesthetic medicine professional, SNSA gives you access to a valuable network. Discover the latest trends and brands in natural skincare. Take part in dedicated training and expert events and strengthen your professional visibility within a growing industry community.

card3.title: Empower Your Skincare
card3.description: Are you passionate about skincare and conscious about your health? Join SNSA to stay informed about the latest natural skincare products, emerging trends, scientific discoveries and innovations. Stay up to date and become increasingly aware of the products you use every day.

card1.title: SNSA Quality Mark
card1.description: The SNSA Quality Mark recognizes brands and products that meet defined standards of quality and responsible natural skincare, helping consumers identify companies committed to excellence, scientific integrity and transparency.

card2.title: Science&Natural Skincare
card2.description: Through its Scientific Committee, SNSA promotes rigorous evaluation, knowledge exchange and a responsible approach to ingredients, formulations, sustainability and cosmetic communication.

card1.title: Our Mission
card1.description: To create an independent platform for natural skincare where scientific knowledge, responsible business practices and industry collaboration can develop together.

card2.title: Quality
card2.description: We promote higher standards in natural skincare through transparent criteria, independent assessment and continuous improvement.

card3.title: Research
card3.description: We encourage dialogue between science and industry, translating research and technical expertise into meaningful practices for skincare brands and professionals.

cta.subtitle: Unisciti all'associazione svizzera di riferimento. Ottieni il badge di certificazione.

label.title: The Label
label.subtitle: Certification Standard
label.description: Everything is transparent: the people behind the assessment are publicly identified, and the association is an open organisation committed to sharing its results and evaluations. The Quality Mark is awarded based on specific requirements established with a pragmatic approach, designed to assess the product’s actual impact on the environment and on well-being.

card.title: Transparent & Independent
card.description: The assessment protocol is fully public and transparent. The members of the scientific committee, responsible for the evaluation, are also publicly identified and are carefully selected by the association based on their expertise across a wide range of fields.

criteria1.title: Ingredients & Formulation
criteria1.description: Natural and natural-origin ingredients, formulation choices and overall composition.

criteria2.title: Origin & Processing
criteria2.description: Traceability, sourcing, cultivation, harvesting and processing of key raw materials.

criteria3.title: Ethics & Sustainability
criteria3.description: Environmental impact, biodiversity, responsible sourcing and animal welfare.

criteria4.title: Packaging
criteria4.description: Material choices, recyclability, resource use and unnecessary secondary packaging.

criteria5.title: Transparency & Claims
criteria5.description: Accuracy and transparency of product communication, environmental claims and marketing.

basic.title: Basic
basic.subtitle: Essential Natural Certification
basic.desc: It ensures compliance with basic criteria for natural formulation, good level of ingredient traceability and clarity in communication.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.subtitle: Enhanced Sustainable Quality
advanced.desc: Demonstrates a superior standard for a sustainable supply chain, superior chois of materials for packaging and high level of organic ingredients.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.subtitle: The Gold Standard of Natural Skincare
excellence.desc: Excellence that includes all the areas examined by the commitee, which denotes intense research for product development and a vision for the future in this sector.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Process
howItWorks.description: A rigorous, multi-stage evaluation process ensuring complete compliance and transparency.

box1.title: Application
box1.description: Submission of product details, ingredient declarations, and company documentation.

box2.title: Documentation Review
box2.description: Initial screening to verify completeness, compliance, and preliminary requirements.

box3.title: Scientific Evaluation
box3.description: In-depth technical analysis conducted by qualified scientific committee members.

box4.title: Technical Report
box4.description: Compilation of detailed findings, compliance metrics, and assessment outcome.

box5.title: Quality Mark Decision
box5.description: Formal evaluation and awarding of the appropriate Quality Mark recognition level.

box6.title: Annual Verification
box6.description: Ongoing monitoring and periodic reviews to ensure continuous standard adherence.

pageHeader.title: Supporting the Next Generation of Skincare Brands
pageHeader.description: Building a skincare brand requires more than a good formulation. Regulatory requirements, positioning, communication, distribution and access to the right professional network can determine whether an idea becomes a sustainable business. We strongly believe in a new approach based on collaboration between companies. The challenges of today, the multidisciplinary knowledge required and the increasing importance of internationalisation, make synergies between companies operating in the same sector extremely valuable.

box1.title: Consulting & Guidance
box1.description: Strategic support throughout the development of your skincare business.

box2.title: Training
box2.description: Workshops and educational opportunities covering key areas of the cosmetic industry.

box3.title: Networking & Partnerships
box3.description: Connections with brands, laboratories, professionals, retailers and industry partners.

box4.title: Information & Opportunities
box4.description: Access to relevant industry information, initiatives and business opportunities.

box5.title: Representation of Interests
box5.description: A collective voice supporting the interests and development of responsible skincare businesses.

box6.title: Services & Agreements
box6.description: Access to selected services, collaborations and agreements developed for SNSA members.

ctaBanner.title: Do you have a skincare idea ready to grow?
ctaBanner.subtitle: Tell us about your project and discover how the SNSA network can support its development.

card1.title: Workshops
card1.description: Hands-on sessions designed to explore specific topics in depth, from natural ingredients and formulation to scientific innovation, sustainability, regulation and emerging technologies. Our workshops combine expert knowledge with practical insights and encourage active participation.

card2.title: Courses & Training
card2.description: Educational programmes developed to strengthen knowledge and professional expertise across the natural skincare sector. Courses may cover scientific, technical, regulatory, business and sustainability topics, helping professionals stay informed in a rapidly evolving industry.

card3.title: Conferences
card3.description: High-level events bringing together leading experts, researchers, companies and professionals to discuss the latest developments in natural skincare. Conferences provide a platform for sharing research, exploring emerging trends and fostering dialogue between science and industry.

card4.title: Talks & Expert Sessions
card4.description: Focused conversations with scientists, formulators, industry leaders and other specialists. These sessions offer accessible insights into key topics and provide an opportunity to question, challenge and explore new perspectives.

card5.title: Roundtables & Industry Forums
card5.description: Small-group discussions bringing together different voices from across the sector. Roundtables are designed to encourage open dialogue around shared challenges, opportunities, standards, innovation and the responsible development of natural skincare.

card6.title: Networking & Community Events
card6.description: Informal and professional gatherings that create space for members to connect, exchange ideas, discover potential collaborations and build lasting relationships within the SNSA community.

events.text2: Whether you are looking to deepen your expertise, discover new scientific perspectives, meet potential partners or contribute to the development of natural skincare, SNSA events offer a space to connect with a community committed to advancing the sector.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy and Legal Notices
privacy.description: This Privacy Policy describes how this website collects, uses, and protects users' personal data, in accordance with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP) and, where applicable, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) of the European Union.

dataController.title: Data Controller
dataController.desc: The data controller responsible for processing personal data is:

dataTypes.title: Types of Data Collected and Purposes of Processing

pointA.title: Contact Form
pointA.desc: When users submit the contact form available on the website, we collect the following data:

list.list5: Subject and content of the message
list.list6: Privacy Consent: Electronic record of the user's acceptance of the Privacy Policy at the time of submission.

pointA.desc2: Purpose: Data is collected exclusively to respond to information or support requests submitted by users. Legal Basis: Processing is based on the user's explicit consent given at the time of form submission and on the implementation of pre-contractual measures.

pointB.title: Member Management
pointB.desc: For members and organizations listed in the directory:

list.list1: Personal and descriptive information about the organization, website, location, and logos/images uploaded through the administrative dashboard.

processing.title: Processing Methods and Location (Infrastructure and Security)
processing.desc: Users' data is processed using technical and organizational security measures designed to prevent unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction of data.

list.list1: Database (Neon.tech / PostgreSQL): Data collected through the website's forms is stored in a secure cloud database powered by PostgreSQL.
list.list2: Hosting and Distribution (Netlify): The website is hosted on high-performance cloud platforms that ensure data transmission is encrypted using the HTTPS protocol.
list.list3: Media Storage (Uploadthing): Uploaded images and logos are stored on secure external cloud storage services that operate in compliance with applicable privacy regulations.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.desc: Personal data submitted through the contact form will be retained only for as long as strictly necessary to handle the user's request and, in any case, for no longer than [e.g. 12 months], unless legal or accounting obligations require a longer retention period.

sharingData.title: Sharing Data with Third Parties
sharingData.desc: Personal data is not sold, transferred, or otherwise commercialized to third parties. It may only be processed by trusted technical service providers (e.g. hosting and database providers) acting as data processors and bound by confidentiality agreements.

userRights.title: User Rights (nLPD / GDPR)
userRights.desc: In accordance with applicable regulations, users have the right to:

list.list1: Obtain confirmation as to whether or not their personal data is being processed and access its content and source.
list.list2: Request the updating, correction, or, where applicable, completion of their personal data.
list.list3: Request the deletion, anonymization, or blocking of data processed in violation of the law.
list.list4: Object, in whole or in part and on legitimate grounds, to the processing of their personal data.
list.list5: Withdraw their consent at any time (without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent given prior to its withdrawal).

userRights.desc2: To exercise these rights, users may submit a written request to the Data Controller's email address: [Insert Email].

changes.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.desc: The Data Controller reserves the right to amend this Privacy Policy at any time by publishing the updated version on this page. Users are advised to review this page regularly.
